spec.name: Orange Kitchen Griddle
spec.description: Premium vanilla-style diner griddle with a stainless cabinet, inset door, red heat controls, ten individual cast-iron bars, rear splashback and warm oak trim. The main station occupies a 16×16×16 block envelope; the rear splashback reaches y20. Front faces -Z.

prompt: Generate a high-quality Minecraft Java kitchen griddle station for Orange SMP Kitchen, industrial cozy diner aesthetic. Main collision cabinet exactly x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front facing -Z. Stainless body with inset cabinet door, handle, vent slits, two red/black heat controls, dark cast-iron grill grate at y15 with individual grill bars, lightly heat-stained metal, short splashback at rear only up to y20, small wood-trim detail to match Minecraft kitchens. 30-55 intentional cuboids. ONE shared 64x64 texture atlas, per-face UVs with detailed material shading, metal edge highlights and subtle purposeful wear. All surfaces textured, no flat unpainted slabs. No food or text or scenery. It will be shown with item displays on a barrier block; it must look like a finished premium custom block.
